name: 09-questing-beast
description: Questing Beast: a green snake's head on a long green neck, a tawny golden leopard body with dark spots, four thin deer legs with hooves, a thin tail. Flat black-outline pixel art.

idle.action: Standing in place, its snake head sways on its long neck and flicks out a thin red forked tongue, then draws it back. Body and legs still. Same facing, same size. Black one-pixel outlines, flat fills.

walk.action: Galloping in place: its four thin deer legs reach out and gather under it in a gallop, the spotted body rising and falling a little, neck and snake head held forward. Same facing, same size, ground line. Black one-pixel outlines, flat fills.
